expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/

expectations.text: The plan notes that only monthly or quarterly data is available and daily data or access is missing
expectations.evidence: Needs: 有：data/q3-metrics.csv（仅 3 行月度汇总）；缺（阻塞）：日级数据。

expectations.evidence: Judge: 留出时间窗上的回测。Done: 用历史数据证明它会更早发现问题，再和季报并行跑一个季度。
